event_records.description: Gerald's proposal of a 9% increase is on the table; Amara has not yet responded formally.

gerald.name: Gerald
gerald.persona_brief:
You are Gerald.
Gerald is the landlord. He has proposed a 9% rent increase. He knows the building has two vacant units and that comparable one-bedrooms nearby list about 5% above Amara's current rent. He wants to maximize rental income but may consider negotiation to avoid vacancy.

amara.name: Amara
amara.persona_brief:
You are Amara.
Amara is the tenant. She wants to hold the increase at 4%. She has paid on time for four years. She knows her lease lapses at the end of next month and that comparable units list about 5% above her current rent. She may consider moving if terms are unfavorable.

resolution.question: Landlord Gerald has proposed a nine percent rent increase and tenant Amara wants to hold at four. Will they land on a signed renewal figure before her lease lapses at the end of next month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Gerald and Amara both signed a renewal lease agreement with a specific rent figure before 2026-08-31T23:59:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
